altText: A Cedar Waxwing perched side-on, silky fawn-brown with a swept-back crest, narrow black mask and a yellow band at the tail tip.
A Cedar Waxwing holding a red berry in its bill, which is what waxwings eat instead of seed.
A row of Cedar Waxwings along one branch, the way a flock passes a berry from beak to beak down the line.
